skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand the nature, characteristics, and key components of communication; understand the goals and roles of environmental communication.
Analyze and compare various models and approaches of environmental communication.
Develop and implement communication plans for environmental issues, including understanding the stages and principles of behavior change communication.
Design and implement communication strategies to promote environmental behavior change in different geographical areas and conflict situations.
Work independently and in teams to gather, synthesize, and present information through presentations and discussions.
Apply critical thinking to analyze and solve problems related to environmental communication.
Develop and deliver effective presentations on environmental communication topics.
Conduct research and analyze data to support communication strategies.
Identify and solve problems related to environmental communication in different contexts.
